sn35.145:1.2: yopi hetu yopi paccayo rūpānaṃ uppādāya so anattā
sn35.145:1.3: anattasambhūtā bhikkhave rūpā kuto attā bhavissanti.
sn35.145:1.9: yopi hetu yopi paccayo dhammānaṃ uppādāya sopi anattā
sn35.145:1.10: anattasambhūtā bhikkhave dhammā kuto attā bhavissanti.
sn35.145:1.11: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpesu nibbindati saddesu gandhesu rasesu phoṭṭhabbesu dhammesu nibbindati
sn35.145:1.12: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.145:1.13: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
